cohort: Women aged 15 to 54 years who had delivery hospitalizations in the United States between 2000 and 2018
finding: Rates of VTE risk factors and pulmonary embolism increased among women in the United States between 2000 and 2018, while DVT increased only among vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: DVT increased during vaginal delivery hospitalizations but not during cesarean delivery hospitalizations.
